Sample_N_Approx.reason: Confirmed. The trial randomised 48 MCI patients (24 per arm). One patient per arm dropped out and 46 completed (Table 2: Total entered 48, completed 46). The outcome tables analyse n = 23 per arm (Tables 4-7). The registry's bare '48' is the randomised figure, and the registry does not say so. That is the enrolled-versus-analysed case the definition calls defensible. It is not an error, because the paper states 48, and not a match, because the registry string does not say it is the enrolled N. Table 3 gives an inconsistent 28/18 arm split, but that also sums to 46.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: In this paper, 48 MCI patients admitted to the hospital were randomly assigned to the control group and the treatment group for control observation
Sample_N_Approx.supporting_quote: During the treatment, 1 case in the control group and the treatment group dropped out respectively, and a total of 46 cases were effectively completed.
